name: prufrock-gate
description: The gate's command runner only (NOR-391). Prufrock itself is Python; these npm scripts run the checks, in the shape of modelcontextprotocol/servers' root package.json. See AGENTS.md.

scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/validate-py.test.mjs && node --test scripts/coverage-py.test.mjs && node --test scripts/lib/py-coverage.test.mjs && node --test scripts/verify-coverage-scope-py.test.mjs && node --test scripts/verify-action-pins.test.mjs && node --test scripts/dco-check.test.mjs && node --test scripts/lib/main-module.test.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run verify:action-pins && npm run test:scripts && npm run validate:py
scripts.local:gate: npm run validate && npm run local:dco && npm run coverage
